sections.title: Lenovo Yoga C740
content: El truco secreto del Lenovo Yoga C740 es su diseño versátil con bisagra de 360 grados, convirtiéndose fácilmente de portátil a tableta para adaptarse a tus necesidades diarias. Además, cuenta con una potencia impresionante gracias al procesador Intel Core Ultra 7, asegurando un rendimiento óptimo.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 599 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
features: VERSATILE & DURABLE DESIGN - Featuring a x360 degree hinge, it allows Flex 'Laptop' mode for everyday computing, 'Yoga' mode for sharing things, 'Flip' convertible mode for binge-watching, or 'Tablet' mode Spin for more intuitive interaction. Built to last with MIL-STD-810H durability testing, and with up to 13 hours of battery life and Rapid Charge technology, you can stay productive on the go - perfect for commuting, travel, or remote work

POWERFUL PERFORMANCE - Powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 155U Processor (12 cores, up to 4.8 GHz) with Intel Graphics, this laptop delivers efficient performance with AI-enhanced productivity to boost your workflow. Equipped with 16GB DDR5 7467 MHz RAM and 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIE SSD, enabling smooth multitasking and fast loading across a wide range of applications

STUNNING DISPLAY - This laptop features a 16" WUXGA IPS touchscreen, coupled with Dolby Vision, 300-nit brightness, and TÜV Low Blue Light certification for vibrant visuals and smooth motion. Supports expanding the workspace with 3 external monitors via HDMI (max 4K@60Hz) or Thunderbolt 4 (max 8K@60Hz), without a docking station. Plus, the 1080p IR camera with privacy shutter ensures crisp video calls and secure facial recognition login

VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY - Featuring 2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen 1, HDMI 2.1, a headphone/microphone combo jack, and a microSD card reader, this device ensures seamless connectivity with a wide range of peripherals and displays. Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax and Bluetooth 5.3 deliver fast wireless performance, while the backlit keyboard allows for comfortable work in any lighting, and the fingerprint reader enhances security

OPERATING SYSTEM - Pre-installed with Microsoft Windows 11 Home, featuring built-in security such as Windows Defender and device encryption for everyday protection. Enhanced by AI Copilot, it enables smarter and more efficient productivity for work and creativity
